name: endroit/release
description: Resolve, preview, lock, verify and observe multi-Site Releases without delivering them.

capabilities.description: Resolve and qualify Workplace-owned Releases over Site-owned exports.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Resolve one Release and its logical Site exports.

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Run a declared Site preview in the foreground.

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Check or write a deterministic Release lock.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify a locked Release against current local evidence.

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Wait read-only for a locked Release to become current.

commands.name: observe
commands.description: Record an explicitly observed Site effect.
